صَالٌّ : see صَلْصَالٌ, in two places. ―
-b2- Also, [app. a part. n. used as a subst.,] Water that falls upon the ground, which then cracks, (O, K,) or, as in the L, which then dries (فَيَيْبَسُ فَتَجِفُّ [correctly فَتَيْبَسُ فَتَجِفُّ, as referring to الأَرْض, or rather فَتَيْبَسُ وَتَجِفُّ]), causing a sound to be heard. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
